$comment: The board's quests: the seven types the hall's board will carry on the server, as excursions into the zones around Alexandria (data/zones.json). A posting is a template filled for a zone and a day: {zone} the zone's name, {entry}/{post}/{elite} its areas, {beast} the zone's common beast, {named} the zone's named beast, {poster} who posted it. Steps run on the Academy's step engine (goal types: travel, fell, hold, reach, find, talk, extract, spar, escort, carry). limit is a step's timer in seconds: when it runs out the quest fails. pay is in Marks by line colour; witness is what the genius takes from it.

compact: The Compact, by the station clerk
archive: The Archive of the Old Hall

linework.name: Linework
linework.title: Relight {post}
linework.posting: The post at {post} went dark two nights ago. Reach it, clear the ground, and hold it until the resonance takes. The Compact pays Standing and the line stays lit.

lines: The car runs out under the lamps and then past them. {zone} at night: the line's own dark.
The Compact's walker rides the tender. "The post is dark. Clear what hunts it and hold it till it takes. Nobody is a hero tonight."

steps.title: The approach
steps.text: Fell what hunts the way in. Your party fights beside you; [b]Tab[/b] passes the lock round a pack.

steps.title: The post
steps.text: Take the post ([b]E[/b]) and hold it for three beats: a minute, whatever comes.

steps.title: Extraction
steps.text: The post holds. Back to the car ([b]E[/b] at the line back).

lines: The post's flame steadies to blue behind you. The walker signs the ledger without looking up.
On the way back the line is lit as far as you can see.

linework.writeup: Relit a dark post on {zone} for the Compact and held it until it took.
linework.failed: The post stayed dark. The Compact sent a crew in the morning.

salvage.name: Salvage
salvage.title: A thing from {post}
salvage.posting: Something of the Archive's lies in {post}: a page, a plate, a piece of the old hall. Find it and carry it out. Whoever carries it may not fire a Pattern; the field would take it.

lines: The archivist rides with you and does not say what the thing is. "You will know it. Do not fire a Pattern with it in your hands."

steps.title: The way in
steps.text: Fell what hunts the way in.

steps.title: The thing
steps.text: It is here somewhere, in {post}. Find it ([b]E[/b] to pick it up). Once you carry it, no Patterns.

steps.title: Carry it out
steps.text: Back to the car with it, through whatever is between. No Patterns while you carry.

lines: The archivist takes the thing in both hands and says nothing for a long moment.
"Three of these make a technique, at the Archive. Remember that, after the Gate."

salvage.writeup: Carried a thing of the Archive's out of {zone} without a Pattern fired.
salvage.failed: The thing was dropped and the field took it. The Archive will post it again.

hunt.name: Hunt
hunt.title: {named}
hunt.posting: {named} has come down to the line again. It has a name because it has been hunted before and lived. Fell it, and fell it quickly: it remembers parties that run. The town pays in kind and the hall keeps the trophy.

lines: A woman from the town rides out with you to point the way and will not go further than the car. "It took two dogs and a boy's hand. It knows the sound of the car now."

steps.title: Its ground
steps.text: Its pack hunts the way in. Fell them.

steps.title: {named}
steps.text: {named} itself. You have the time it takes to lose its patience: fell it before the timer runs out, or it goes to ground for another season.

steps.title: Extraction
steps.text: Back to the car.

lines: The woman from the town looks at what you carry and sits down on the tender's step.

hunt.writeup: Hunted {named} on {zone} and felled it before it went to ground.
hunt.failed: {named} went to ground. It will remember the car.

escort.name: Escort
escort.title: A passenger to {post}
escort.posting: A passenger of ours must reach the post at {post} tonight and must not be touched. Walk beside them. If they fall, the house will not forget it; if they arrive, the house will not forget that either.

lines: The passenger is a classmate's age and does not give a name. The house's man says: "To the post. Then they are the Compact's problem."

steps.title: Beside them
steps.text: {passenger} walks beside you. Fell what comes, and keep them standing: if they fall, the quest is lost.

steps.title: To the post
steps.text: Get {passenger} to the post ([b]E[/b] to take it) and hold it until the car comes.

steps.title: Extraction
steps.text: They are the Compact's now. Back to the car.

lines: {passenger} says a name at the post, to the Compact's walker, and not to you.
The house's man meets the car at Alexandria and counts you, and then the passenger, and nods.

escort.writeup: Walked a house's passenger through {zone} to the post, untouched.
escort.failed: The passenger fell on the way. The house noticed.

writ.name: Writ
writ.title: A writ for {post}
writ.posting: The house wants a thing retrieved from {post} before the other house's party reaches it. A decision will be asked of you at the end, and the Charter gives you the time it takes the car to come. Favour with the house either way; its rival will know your name.

lines: The house's clerk gives you a sealed writ and a time. "Before the other car. What you do with it after is between you and the Charter."

steps.title: Before the other car
steps.text: Fell what is between you and {post}. The other house's party is an hour behind: the timer.

steps.title: The thing
steps.text: The writ's thing is in {post}. Find it.

steps.title: The decision
steps.text: The writ says the thing is the house's. The Archive would say otherwise. Decide.

options.label: Give it to the house
options.text: The writ is the writ. Favour with the house; its rival will remember.

options.label: Send it to the Archive
options.text: The Charter allows it. The house will not pay; the Archive will know your name.

steps.title: Extraction
steps.text: Back to the car.

lines: The other house's car passes yours on the way in. Nobody waves.

writ.writeup: Served a house's writ on {zone} and made the decision the Charter leaves to the hand that carries it.
writ.failed: The other car got there first. The house will not post with you again this season.

deep-run.name: Deep Run
deep-run.title: The deep run: {zone}
deep-run.posting: Varga's posting, for those with the field open: {zone} to its heart in one run, the post and the beast that holds it, one extraction. Amber. The rescue team rides the tender and nobody is a hero.

lines: Varga rides out with you and says nothing until the lamps are gone. "To the heart of it. One extraction. If I say we go, we go."

steps.title: The way in
steps.text: Fell what hunts the way in.

steps.title: The post
steps.text: Take the post and hold it.

steps.title: The heart
steps.text: What holds {zone}. Fell it.

steps.title: Extraction
steps.text: Back to the car.

lines: Varga counts you onto the car, twice. "That was a run. Write it down tonight; you will want it later."

deep-run.writeup: Ran {zone} to its heart with the field open and came back with everyone.
deep-run.failed: The deep run was cut short. Varga called the extraction.

rally.name: Rally
rally.title: The Friday rally
rally.posting: Friday in the yard: three bouts against the cohort's best, in front of whoever is watching. The Compact keeps the standings. Win two of three.

steps.title: The rally
steps.text: Three bouts. Win two.

steps.title: Standings
steps.text: Bask has the standings. Hear them ([b]E[/b] with Instructor Bask).

rally.writeup: Took the Friday rally and won it.
rally.failed: Lost the Friday rally. The standings are the standings.

lines.taken: Taken. The car leaves from the quad's south door; your party is whoever you choose.
lines.inHand: You have a posting in hand already: {title}.
lines.nothing: Nothing on the board for you today. Rest, and it will be posted again.
lines.done: {title}: done. {pay} Marks, and the hall knows it.
lines.failed: {title}: lost. No Marks; the board will carry it again.
lines.carrying: You carry the thing: no Patterns.
